SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, you rearranged your room for the boarding house?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过你搞个合租房怎么还把房间给换了?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不過你搞個合租房怎麼還把房間給換了?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 下宿するために部屋変えるって言ってなかたっけ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hei, kamu atur ulang kamarmu buat rumah kos?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, você rearrumou seu quarto pra pensão?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Эй, ты переставил комнату для съемщиков?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Hé, t’as réorganisé ta chambre pour la pension ?

SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هی، اتاقت را برای پانسیون مرتب کردی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t drink beer on the bed...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ああ…ベッドでビール飲むなって何回言わすんだよ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jangan minum bir di atas kasur...
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Ne bois pas de bière sur le lit...
SCRIPT.THAI: อย่าดื่มเบียร์บนเตียงสิ...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What are you going to do now?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que você vai fazer agora?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Et maintenant, qu’est-ce que tu vas faire ?
SCRIPT.THAI: แล้วตอนนี้จะทำไงต่อ?

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 이제 엄마 집에 안 계셔가지고 방에서 다시 쉰내 나는 거 아니야?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: With your mom not around, isn’t your room going to start smelling again?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 妈妈不在家，房间里不会又要馊了吧?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 媽媽不在家，房間裏不會又要餿了吧?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 今、お母さんが家にいないから、その間また部屋が臭くなるんじゃないの？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tanpa mamamu di sini, kayaknya kamar kamu bakal bau lagi deh?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sem sua mãe por perto, seu quarto não vai começar a feder de novo?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Без мамы твоя комната снова начнет вонять, да?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Sans ta mère, ta chambre va pas recommencer à puer ?
SCRIPT.THAI: ไม่มีแม่อยู่ด้วย ห้องนายคงเริ่มเหม็นอีกแน่เลยใช่ไหม?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: با نبودن مادرت، اتاقت دوباره بو نمی دهد؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 하긴 뭐 빨래는 내 거 돌릴 때 같이 돌리면 되니까.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Well, you can throw my laundry in with yours when you do it.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过没关系，我洗衣服的时候把你的也一起洗了不就行了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不過沒關係，我洗衣服的時候把你的也一起洗了不就行了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: まあでも、私が洗濯する時に、あんたのも一緒に回せばいいか。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya, kamu bisa campurin cucianku sama cucianmu kalau lagi nyuci.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Bom, você pode jogar minhas roupas pra lavar junto com as suas.
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Ну, можешь заодно и мое белье постирать.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Au fait, tu peux laver mon linge avec le tien quand t’y penses.
SCRIPT.THAI: เออ เธอซักผ้าฉันไปพร้อมกับของเธอด้วยละกัน
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خوب، وقتی این کار را انجام دادی، می‌تونی لباس‌های من را با لباس‌هایت بیاندازی.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Throw in your laundry with mine?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Lavar minhas roupas junto com as suas?

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 別說這個啦，我們還是看相冊吧!

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Lupain deh, yuk cek albumnya aja!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Esquece isso, vamos conferir o álbum!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Забудь об этом, давай лучше посмотрим альбом!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Laisse tomber, on regarde l’album à la place !
